text:
A bubble of gas is formed deep under water. The bubble has a volume of 40cm3 and the
pressure inside the bubble is P.
The bubble rises up through the water. The volume of the bubble increases to 56cm3 and the
pressure becomes 100kPa. The temperature of the gas does not change.
What is the initial pressure P?
A
71Pa
B
71kPa
C
140Pa
D
140kPa
subject: Physics
